coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Busch et al. (2006), Icarus 181, 145–155; Goldstone, optical observatories and NASA/JPL radar astronomy: ecliptic J2000 lambda 99 deg, beta -3 deg, period 7.3182 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. This is the published 2006 combined radar and lightcurve model. The north polar region is poorly constrained and some structure there may be a fitting artifact. Its diameter uncertainty is about 20%. Later lightcurves favor a different pole and measured rotational acceleration; this historical model retains its original pole and period with arbitrary display phase, not a current attitude. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
